name: MarketPlaceLens
description: MarketPlaceLens is a self-hosted Kleinanzeigen and marketplace watcher with recurring search jobs, review queues, watchlists, and optional AI-assisted buyer workflows.

paths.name: App Data
paths.description: Persistent MarketPlaceLens data, including SQLite database, settings, users, watchlists, notifications, and session secret.

ports.name: Web UI Port
ports.description: Host port for the MarketPlaceLens Web UI.

variables.name: Poll Enabled
variables.description: Enable recurring background polling for active marketplace jobs.

variables.name: Default Poll Minutes
variables.description: Default polling interval for new marketplace jobs, in minutes.

variables.name: Minimum Poll Minutes
variables.description: Minimum allowed polling interval for marketplace jobs, in minutes.

variables.name: User Agent
variables.description: HTTP User-Agent used by marketplace fetchers.

variables.name: Admin Username
variables.description: Optional bootstrap admin username. Used only when an admin password is supplied before first startup.

variables.name: Admin Password
variables.description: Optional bootstrap admin password for unattended first startup. Leave empty to use the guided Web UI setup.

variables.name: Session Secret
variables.description: Optional fixed session secret for restores or migrations. Leave empty for normal first startup; MarketPlaceLens will generate and persist one in appdata.

variables.name: Telegram Bot Token
variables.description: Optional Telegram bot token for listing notifications. Can also be configured later in the UI.

variables.name: Telegram Chat ID
variables.description: Optional Telegram chat ID for listing notifications. Can also be configured later in the UI.

variables.name: Webhook URL
variables.description: Optional webhook URL for listing notifications. Can also be configured later in the UI.
